items.title: Sweet Williams Interview
items.q: That's all I know. Little Willie. He played here like Hell. Used to have jam sessions between him and the great guy.

ctx.x: What else do you know about him? Do you know his real name?
He never did the car. I don't know nothing he records. No, but do you know his real name? No. I know he had another brother. They called Yellow. He played too. Yellow what?
Yellow what? I don't know. I don't know. Yellow Butch? Could that be?
